title: DHW set-point Fix writes the disinfection floor above the entity's own max on a pump capped below it
claim: On a plant whose DHW set-point entity's declared maximum (55 degC) is below the notice's floor (60 degC while a legionella cycle is active), the confirmed dhw_setpoint_below_disinfection Fix sends 60 to the entity on every one of the four DHW set-point domains, with or without an immersion disinfection switch: 8 of 12 Fix writes fall outside the entity's own range, 0 under an entity-capped quantisation.
mechanism: setpoint_check._dhw quantises the floor with quantise_setpoint_c(..., rounding='up', hi_c=params.dhw_hard_max_temp) and never with the entity's own max (inputs.setpoint_range_c); repairs.DhwSetpointRepairFlow writes that value through inputs.write_setpoint. The arbiter's own writes are bounded by the entity range (pump_arbiter._bounded, duties.py 0 bad of 120), so only the Fix path skips it; the notice can then never clear on that plant, and Home Assistant refuses an out-of-range number/climate/water_heater value.

evidence.unit: Fix writes (of 12) outside the target entity's own declared range (RESULT bad_fix_writes)
evidence.machine: box B6, Linux x86_64, python 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats on B6 and this seat's two entry-mode runs (load1 9-10); a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb entity-cap: setpoint_check.quantise_setpoint_c called with hi_c = min(hi_c, inputs.setpoint_range_c(entity)[1]) (one-line production edit in setpoint_check._dhw)

metric_definition: Per (DHW set-point domain x entity range) cell, confirmed-Fix service calls whose value is outside the entity's own declared range (min_temp/max_temp or min/max).
phenomenon_property: Every set-point write the integration sends -- arbiter, Fix flow, or any other writer -- lands inside the target entity's own declared range, on every set-point domain the tree accepts.

null_control.value: 0 of 4 bad on the entity range [40,65] that holds the floor; duties.py (arbiter writes) 0 of 120 bad on both arms
null_control.note: Not a cost claim; the in-range arm is the null.

reproduction_steps: run repairs_surfaces.py: CELL *:capped and *:capped_immersion print BAD value 60 outside [30,55]; RESULT bad_fix_writes=8
proposed_fix_scope: setpoint_check._dhw: cap the Fix value at the entity's own max (and say in the notice that the entity cannot hold the floor, or do not raise it where a disinfection switch runs the cycle)
